exposure: abnormal duration of the first stage of term labor
prolonged first stage of labor duration
outcome: Maternal morbidity (composite of maternal fever, hemorrhage, transfusion, endomyometritis, prolonged second stage of labor duration, and third- or fourth-degree perineal laceration)

Neonatal morbidity (composite of hypothermic therapy, need for mechanical ventilation, respiratory distress syndrome, meconium aspiration syndrome, birth injury or trauma, and neonatal seizure or sepsis)
cohort: 6823 women admitted for delivery at a single center between 2010 and 2015, at ≥37 weeks and 0 to 7 days of gestation, with singleton, nonanomalous, vertex infants, who reached 10 cm cervical dilation
finding: Women with a first stage of labor duration above the 90th percentile had an increased risk of both maternal and neonatal morbidity.
